content:
For the <span id="assignment.55.1"/>, enter:

```yaml
#cloud-config
packages:
  - qemu-guest-agent
runcmd:
  - - systemctl
    - enable
    - --now
    - qemu-guest-agent.service
write_files:
  - path: /etc/issue
    content: |
      \e{red}Production\e{reset}
    append: true
ssh_authorized_keys:
  - ssh-ed25519
    AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIFdt8wX4G0WGg/l4uDq/LntBO7WiNyqh0+pNUzF/NfMa
```

Save the template by clicking in <span id="assignment.19.3"/> (inside the template box)


Since the template lives in the <span id="assignment.55.2"/> namespace and is itself named <span id="assignment.55.2"/>, it becomes prod/prod: the production standard, ready to use for every VM.
